text: Been on hold for ages and then got told to text, so here goes. I'm fostering a 2 year old boy, temp 39.4 about 20 mins ago. He's had runny poos today but he's drinking loads and his nappies are wet as normal. He won't settle to sleep tonight, keeps getting up, but apart from that he's himself. No fits, no shaking or jerking, nothing like that. His cheeks are bright red but that started after we were out in the freezing wind at the park this afternoon, same as my own face, and it's just his cheeks. Social worker's office is shut so I need someone to tell me if he needs seeing tonight or if I just keep going with the fluids.
